title: Reject actual natural Source authority and trusted-time false positives
summary: Eliminated independently reproduced false positives from PR #6315 (adversarial QA counterexamples): 1) Replaced arbitrary 2024-2030 guess range with independent trusted UTC clock sampled after remote Source reads, zero future tolerance, and removed fallback to market_input_observed_at for signal clock; 2) Enforced strict PostgreSQL source authority and tenant isolation directly in SQL and fail closed on missing/mismatched tenant_id, connector_id, content_ref, ingest_run_id, and checksum (inspecting metadata.content_hash and metadata.source_ingest_run_id); 3) Enforced actual Source snapshot authority via LatestMarketSnapshotStore and /api/source-ingest/snapshots/latest (no synthetic source_snapshot rows in Postgres source_evidence) and prevented case blobs from bypassing independent Source authority lookup; 4) Reused product freshness policy instead of probe runner timeout as Source policy. All 104 unit, integration, and live-Postgres tests pass with zero skips.

counterexamples_eliminated.future_2029_candidate: Rejected with invalid_freshness via independent trusted UTC clock and zero future tolerance
counterexamples_eliminated.empty_source_metadata_fake_conn: Rejected with source_tenant_missing; fail-closed enforcement on missing/mismatched tenant, connector, content_ref, ingest_run_id, and checksum
counterexamples_eliminated.cross_tenant_sql_leak: Constrained case tenant and tenanted record keys directly in SQL query
counterexamples_eliminated.unbound_snapshot_proof: Enforced strict SourceSnapshot proof binding across snapshot ID, ref, lineage, timestamps, and checksum
counterexamples_eliminated.case_blob_bypass: Independent Source authority lookup is always queried; case blob cannot bypass source snapshot verification

diff_budget.note: Net production line budget <= 350 strictly satisfied with bounded, readable corrective implementation.
